ops.body: | Place search (Explore: a magnifier beside the title opens a labelled field; typing lists towns and cities from a GeoNames `cities5000` pack bundled in the app, 70,042 places, 5.6 MB, searched on the phone, nearest first with region and country; the pack holds no population; a pick is a look at the place, "Around <name>", Locate returns; nothing stored, nothing sent; GZ1-GZ19, decision 0182) | built 2026-11-16, test-first by intent (5 of 19 by history: the failing commit `fd09d5d` has every criterion's test, but its journey's todos went through an alias `check:test-first` cannot read, and the unit tests for GZ3-GZ6, GZ8 and GZ17 share a commit with a todo of the same id, so the owner may waive it): unit tests (2611), typecheck, lint, docs and vision checks; e2e `placesearch` (with `place-search ui 1-3`), `freelook`, `carousel`, `snap`, `atlas` and the journeys `check:affected` names; steward triaged into the plan (7 findings), cold find placed the magnifier on the first tap (icon-only noted as the owner's call), UI review triaged (3 accepted, 1 deferred, 3 rejected); native unverified; not audited | `claude/exciting-mccarthy-0ktfgm` | `specs/place-search/spec.md` | no |
